1. Context Precision
Relevant retrieved / Total retrieved
Target: > 85%

span.p:
2. Context Recall
Relevant retrieved / Total relevant in DB
Target: > 90%

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Faithfulness
Supported claims / Total claims
Target: 100% | CRITICAL

span.p:
4. Relevance
Answer addresses the question asked
Target: > 0.85 cosine sim

Target: exact match | CRITICAL
